status_meaning: Top-level status 'pass' iff every DR-0002 sub-bound with a ratified Target has Target verdict PASS on complete, valid schematic evidence; any FAIL, INCOMPLETE, GAP, INVALID_DUT or REJECTED_EVIDENCE gives 'fail'. A per-row PASS is a per-point sample statistic against the bound (Row 1: 3 x sample sigma at N = 60 per point; Row 2: grid-wide mean of probit-slope sigma), not a yield or population-compliance claim (that is issue #63).
summary: Schematic characterization of campaign 20261009-d73a9ac: 6/8 bounded DR-0002 Targets pass; blocking: Row 2 Target FAIL; Row 4a Target FAIL. Schematic-only scope; per-row PASS is not a yield claim.
